Module meant to initialize ‘Colbot’ along with loading its’ extensions.

This module contains the primary logic for the Colbot discord client, including custom command handling and automated event listeners. It utilizes the discord.py library as its base.

colbot.TOKEN¶

String token identifier needed to initialize the bot.

Type:

str

colbot.ID¶

Server ID needed to refresh ‘/’ commands on Discord.

int
